messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "re-escalate to 2.4 mg once weekly if lower dose is tolerated"
set: ["re-escalate to 2.4 mg once weekly if lower dose is tolerated", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "reduce dose if not tolerated", "one dose is injected weekly", "once weekly", "increase dosage to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase dosage to 1 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.5 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "starting dose is 12.5 mg capsule once a day", "lower the dose gradually", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "taper dose to 150 mg once a day", "treatment starts at 25 mg once a day if potassium level is 5.0 mEq/L or lower and eGFR is above 50", "initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly", "lower dose gradually where possible", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
